question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin add hybrid BM25 plus vector retrieval now, and should that behavior be opt-in, default-on with fallback, or deferred to community plugins?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but it adds a memory-ranking config surface and affects upgrade behavior for an official memory plugin while VISION.md keeps optional plugin growth and memory convergence under maintainer judgment.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in plugin design
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a narrow `memory-lancedb` implementation that defaults safely until maintainers approve a default-on migration.

options.title: Default-on parity
options.body: Accept hybrid as the new default if maintainers explicitly want LanceDB recall quality to match memory-core by default and require upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub/community
options.body: Close or freeze this if maintainers decide enhanced LanceDB retrieval should remain in external plugins such as the already linked community implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in plugin design
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a narrow `memory-lancedb` implementation that defaults safely until maintainers approve a default-on migration.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` previously reviewed this exact issue and current history points at the current-main memory-lancedb snapshot, making them the best available routing owner for the product/default decision.
